gen-dafont-franchise-gf-noto-serif-henta: Noto Serif Hentaigana has small letters nearly as tall as capitals, open-jawed curves, and a faint, visible swing in stroke weight. Franchise sits above it, strokes cut like ribbon, tightly packed.
gen-dafont-franchise-gf-ovo: Ovo reads with a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and gentle thick-thin rhythm, its curves left spacious at the ends. And Franchise, with no swing in its strokes at all, would make a flat, firm contrast.
gen-dafont-galaxy-fs-bespoke-sans: Commanding and cosmic, Galaxy stacks dense, tall lowercase with generous gaps between letters. Bespoke Sans lowers the height and opens its curves away from the stems, so the two feel sharp against loose.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab reads with tall, rounded lowercase and a gaping c that stays open at any size. Galaxy's unmodulated strokes against that low modulation give the pair a dignified, steady footing.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads big and open, with tall lowercase and curves that leave their mouths unclosed. Galaxy holds one unswelling line width above it, so the heading feels cut from wire while the body feels drawn.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-hanuman: Galaxy looks bent from a single length of wire, dense and tall. Hanuman follows with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s, softer and more traditional beneath it.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-kadwa: Stout, pipe-cleaner lines, cosmic and loose. Kadwa, a serif with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height, brings the strongest quality here: a editorial warmth set against Galaxy's unvarying stroke.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-piazzolla: Galaxy brings plain, unshaded lines in a dense, tall lowercase, spaced loosely and commandingly. And Piazzolla, its lowercase nearly matching its capitals, opens the e like a pried clasp for a refined counterpoint.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-pridi: Pridi stands small letters proud, nearly capital-sized, with generous room between curve ends and stems. But Galaxy keeps a line that never swells or tapers, while Pridi adds the gentle modulation.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-scope-one: Traditional and refined, Scope One spills its counters into surrounding space beside a big x-height. Galaxy's fixed nib width above it makes the stubby serif text feel softer and the heading sterner.
